requirements.quote: Replace the placeholder at apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/drafts/page.tsx with an RSC list (title, matter, template, last edited, citation and consistency summary chips; matter filter)
loading.tsx, error.tsx (request id), empty, offline and permission-denied states
a create-draft server action (drafts/actions.ts) listed in ACTIONS in apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts
stories for every component and state

deliverables.change: RSC list modelled on notices/page.tsx and matters/page.tsx: getWorkspaceContext, dev ?__state=loading|error|denied|offline, matter filter from validated ?matter= UUID, loads listDrafts + listTemplates via lib/drafting loader inside inWorkspace; FORBIDDEN or no draft.read renders PermissionDeniedPage; empty state; rows link to /w/{slug}/drafts/{id}.
Skeleton loading state (copy notices/loading.tsx) with translated label.
Route error boundary showing translated copy and the request id (error.digest) with copy/retry, never error.message; copy [slug]/error.tsx:29-50 and reportError.

'use server' createDraftAction via workspaceAction + WorkspaceScoped (input workspaceId, templateId uuid, matterId uuid|null, title 1..200); calls core createDraft with {db: ctx.tx} and actor from ctx; maps WorkspaceError FORBIDDEN/NOT_FOUND/VALIDATION to ActionError; returns draft id and slug-relative href only; async wrapper export like news/actions.ts. No enqueue, send, share or file.

Server loader and view mapping: listDrafts/listTemplates via inWorkspace returning {kind:'page'|'denied'}; DraftRowView (title, matter, template, updatedAt formatted, citation counts, consistency counts or null); parseMatterParam.
List of rows with citation chips (use CitationStatus from @causedeck/ui/patterns) and consistency summary chips, matter filter select (URL-driven), empty and filtered-empty states.
Client dialog/form: up to 5 suggested templates, title input, optional matter, submit calls createDraftAction then navigates to the new draft; hidden/disabled when offline; shows action error text.
Offline banner reusing useOnline/OfflineBanner pattern from components/matters/matters-offline-banner.tsx, drafting.offline strings.

Stories for drafts list (populated, filtered-empty, empty), template picker (idle, submitting, error), offline banner, loading, error and permission-denied states, in the repo story style (e.g. components/inbox/inbox.stories.tsx).

Add keys under drafting.list/states: matter filter label and all-matters, column/field labels (matter, template, lastEdited), citation and consistency chip text, permission denied, request id, picker title/field labels/errors. Keep single top-level 'drafting' key.
Same keys as en with real Tamil text.
Same keys as en with real Kannada text.
Add 'draft' entries for each new ta/kn key.
Regenerate with pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n i18n:types (also ta.json, kn.json, messages.d.ts; add each as changed generated file).
Import drafts/actions.ts, add createDraftAction to ACTIONS and its probe inputs (workspace B member cannot create a draft from A's matter/template; A unchanged).
Add 'drafts' to REAL_PAGES with a comment pointing at its own page test.

Tests: rows render title, matter, template, chips with text labels; empty and filtered-empty; picker submits createDraftAction (mocked); offline disables create; denied page for FORBIDDEN loader result.

preserve.what: Core drafting exports and signatures in packages/core/src/drafting/index.ts and read.ts; no core changes.
Other workspace routes' placeholderPage behaviour and apps/web/__tests__/workspace-shell.test.tsx expectations for non-drafts routes; nav item 'drafts' in apps/web/lib/nav.ts unchanged.
i18n catalog invariants in packages/i18n/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts: single top-level key 'drafting', ta/kn key sets equal en, generated files in sync.
Existing ACTIONS entries and the exported-actions equality check in apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts.

decisions.choice: Copy the notices/matters page pattern (dev ?__state previews, PermissionDeniedPage, useOnline banner) and the news workspaceAction pattern; no new workspace package dependency.
decisions.justification: apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/notices/page.tsx:1-60 and news/actions.ts:1-45 are the established recipes; @causedeck/core and @causedeck/ui are already web dependencies.

decisions.choice: Matter filter lives in the URL (?matter=<uuid>) so the RSC re-queries listDrafts with matterId; invalid UUID is ignored.
decisions.justification: listDrafts accepts matterId and throws on non-UUID (packages/core/src/drafting/read.ts:116-123); matters list is URL-driven (matters/page.tsx header).

decisions.choice: Studio route drafts/[id] is not built here; rows link to it (owned by #827).
decisions.justification: Issue scope is the list page only; #827 is the studio shell.
